facts.fact: 太平山街（Tai Ping Shan Street）变成一片竹林：翡翠绿的竹竿又粗又高如泼墨笔触，只有高处细叶在微风里轻摆。
facts.anchor: Emerald-green bamboo stems towered in confident brushstrokes, thick and tall. Only the delicate foliage, high overhead, swayed in the gentle breeze.

facts.fact: 启明（Kiamling）脚下地面低沉咆哮，她惊疑中及时后跃，更多矛尖似的竹笋破土而出，嘎吱上长成不祥的巨柱。
facts.anchor: Kiamling stared in confusion as the earth gave a deep growl beneath her. She leapt back just in time, as more spear-like bamboo shoots burst through the ground.

facts.fact: 阴阳之界再次变薄；启明敢拿钱打赌，林心就在「春芽阁」（Pavilion of Spring Buds）——而静玲（Jingling）就在那里。
facts.anchor: The barrier between this world and the next had thinned once again, and Kiamling would have put money on the heart of the forest being located at the Pavilion of Spring Buds.

facts.fact: 启明扒开路中一座莫名隆起的苔堆，露出一张痛苦扭曲的鬼脸：一具欧洲商人的尸体，肌肤灰败、双颊干瘪，像被吸尽了最后一丝气。
facts.anchor: She scraped back the earth, revealing a ghoulish face contorted in agony. The body of a European merchant. His skin was ashen, cheeks hollow and dry, like every last ounce of qi had been sucked out of him.

facts.fact: 启明打了个寒噤，往尸体上撒了一把糯米；米粒一触死者皮肤便嘶嘶作响、变黑，她这才看清竹竿间还有许多同样的苔堆。
facts.anchor: Kiamling shuddered, scattering a handful of glutinous rice over him. The grains hissed as they touched the dead man’s skin, turning black.

facts.fact: 远处传来一个女人的尖叫，启明顿时把谨慎抛到脑后，喊着「静玲！」挥剑斜劈拦路竹竿，竹竿精确裂开、倒向一边。
facts.anchor: “Jingling!” Kiamling slashed down through the bamboo blocking her way. Precise diagonal cuts. Tall stems slid apart and then toppled to one side.

facts.fact: 启明以气助推，把砍断的竹竿当踏石腾空，双脚左右交替如攀一架看不见的梯子，竹竿在她脚下如空鼓回响。
facts.anchor: Her foot pushed off the tall stems, alternating left and right on qi-lightened feet as if she climbed an invisible ladder.

facts.fact: 树下徘徊的正是盂兰节（Hungry Ghost Festival）那头影兽——自鸦片馆外一别它已变形：毛更短更亮、体型近牛、耳弯如角，但眼中红光让她认出是同一头。
facts.anchor: Below her, the shadow beast from the Hungry Ghost Festival prowled. It looked up, baring sharp teeth, red eyes narrowed. It had changed since she last saw it, outside the opium den.

facts.fact: 影兽在下方不断砍断她脚下的竹竿，她跳到哪根哪根即断，只得仓皇换枝，想甩开下方的对手。
facts.anchor: She leapt to the next one, but as soon as her feet landed, it snapped too. Cut down. She jumped again, trying to outrun her opponent below.

facts.fact: 启明把铜钱剑横插进另一根粗竹，再从原处蹬身跃下，落在剑身平面上——这一次剑撑住了。
facts.anchor: She flung her coin sword once more, thrusting it horizontally into another wide bamboo trunk. She pushed herself off her current perch, landing on the flat blade of her embedded sword.

facts.fact: 她以气卷起满地竹叶成球掷向影兽，叶片如镖扎进皮毛；兽嚎叫着抖落，这招只是骚扰，却替她争到爬开的时间。
facts.anchor: The leaves flew from around her, sharp as darts as they embedded into the shadow demon’s pelt. It stopped, howling as it shook the projectiles loose. Nothing more than a nuisance.

facts.fact: 绊倒她的是石阶；阶顶正是那扇双开门——狐精（wulei jing）妓寨熟悉的黄铜门环，如今已长满绿苔。
facts.anchor: Steps, she had tripped over stone steps. Sure enough, she found the double doors of a building at the top, the familiar brass rings of the wulei jing’s brothel, even though they were now green with moss.

facts.fact: 启明砰地关门，一边对撞门的影兽说「不用了，谢谢，我们打烊了，你绝对不受欢迎」，一边用几十张黄符糊住两门之间的缝。
facts.anchor: “Nope, no thank you. We are closed. You are definitely not welcome here,” she said, plastering the seam between the doors with dozens of yellow fu.

facts.fact: 她蘸红墨在符上写尽「止、墙、障、不可越」等字，又想起跑马地（racetrack）的石狮子，额外添上英文的 No entry 与 Go away。
facts.anchor: And remembering the guardian lions at the racetrack, she added No entry and Go away in English.

facts.fact: 她背靠门坐下，影兽每撞一下门板就顶进她肩胛；她用手轻探摔伤处，倒吸一口气——肋骨断了。
facts.anchor: Her ribs ached from where she had fallen, and she prodded them gently with her hand. A gasp escaped her lips. Broken.

facts.fact: 春芽阁内已认不出原样：竹笋从考究的木地板里簇生，不像街上那样竖直成柱，而像拒马般尖头四射、勾住二楼栏杆。
facts.anchor: Inside the Pavilion of Spring Buds, the open room was unrecognisable. Bamboo shoots burst from the fine wooden flooring, but not in the vertical columns of the street outside.

facts.fact: 房中最大一株立在正中央，粗壮树干鼓胀，仿佛树皮下有液体流动、要破皮而出。
facts.anchor: The largest was at the centre of the room. Its wide trunk bulged as though liquid moved beneath the bark, pushing to be let out.

facts.fact: 她嗅到苔藓与阴湿泥土，比此生所历任何地方都更冷更湿——一座来自异乡的森林；章节以她自问「这些是欧洲的树吗」收束。
facts.anchor: She could smell moss, and dank earth, colder and wetter than anything she had ever experienced. A forest from another land.
